invariants.contract: DELETE /api/libraries/:id/issues removes the items flagged missing or invalid with their media, progress, playlist entries, feeds, collection entries and metadata directories, keeps the healthy items and the media files, removes authors and series left without books (keeping the others), answers 200, emits item_removed per item, author_removed and series_removed to every authenticated socket, and resets numIssues to 0.
DELETE issues on a library with no flagged item answers 200 and changes and emits nothing, also when repeated after a removal.
In a podcast library DELETE issues removes the missing podcast with its episodes, their progress and playlist entries (a playlist left empty is deleted), keeps the book library, and resets numIssues.

DELETE issues answers 401 without a token, 403 for a non-admin user (also one with update permission) and for a user without library access, 404 for an unknown library and 400 for an invalid limit before the admin check, and removes nothing while items with issues exist.
